column1: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 05.12.2019
"Disinfectant" shall mean reducing the amount of microorganisms in the environment through chemical agents
or physical means to the level that does not reduce the safety or appropriateness of food,
"Drinking  Water"  shall  mean  water  sufficiently  free  of  contaminants  to  cause  disease  or  adverse  physical
effects and contains bacterial and chemical conditions that meet National standards,
"Food " shall mean any product imported, sold or made for the consumption of human food or beverages and
item commonly taken or used in the composition or preparation of food,
"Lodging and Guest houses” shall mean where any person is temporarily provided with accommodation,
"Reasonable Time" shall mean a time when the license work or related work is done.
